scenario: When a candidate's status flips to 'Offer Accepted' in Greenhouse, create the matching employee record in BambooHR with start date, title, department, manager, and compensation copied from the offer.
Each morning, read BambooHR employees with a start date in the next pay period and create or update them in Gusto with pay rate, pay schedule, and work location so payroll inputs match.
When a time-off request is approved in BambooHR, add an out-of-office event to the employee's Google Calendar and a row in the team's shared 'Who's Out' Google Sheet.

At pay period close, read approved PTO hours from the time-off tracker sheet and enter them as paid leave hours on each employee's draft payroll in QuickBooks Payroll, skipping anyone already entered.
rule_hooks: leave type to pay code map

scenario: When HR sets a termination date in the HRIS, create an offboarding ticket in Jira Service Management listing the person's assigned laptop and app accounts pulled from the IT asset sheet.

After open enrollment closes, copy each employee's medical, dental, and vision elections from the benefits portal export into the carrier's enrollment template sheet, flagging dependents missing birthdates.
Sync completion dates for mandatory harassment-prevention training from the LMS CSV in Google Drive into the compliance fields on each employee's BambooHR profile.
When interviews are booked on the recruiter's Google Calendar, create a scorecard row for each interviewer in the hiring Google Sheet with candidate name, role, and interview stage.
When a requisition is approved in the headcount planning sheet, create the matching job opening in Lever with the approved salary band, location, and hiring manager.

When a referred candidate is hired in Greenhouse, add a row to the referral bonus tracker sheet with referrer, hire date, and the payout date, then create a one-time bonus entry in payroll once 90 days pass.
rule_hooks: referral bonus amount by role tier

scenario: When an employee's manager is changed in Workday, update the reporting line in the Slack profile field, the org chart sheet, and reassign their open Asana onboarding tasks to the new manager.
When a contractor's agreement is fully signed in DocuSign, create their vendor record in QuickBooks with rate and payment terms and add them to the contractor roster sheet.
When a candidate signs an offer letter envelope in DocuSign, update the candidate's stage in Greenhouse to 'Hired' and attach the signed-date to the offer record.
Sync I-9 Section 2 completion dates from the HR compliance sheet into each new hire's BambooHR record and mark anyone past the three-business-day deadline.
After the comp review cycle, read approved raises from the merit review sheet and update each employee's pay rate in Gusto with the effective date, ignoring rows not marked final.
Copy final performance ratings from the Lattice review cycle export into a custom field on each employee's HRIS record, matching on employee ID.
When a new hire's record is created in BambooHR, invite them to the Slack channels mapped to their department and office location.

When a leave of absence is opened in the HR helpdesk (Zendesk), create the matching leave entry in the HRIS with leave type and expected return date and update the payroll status to unpaid where applicable.
Weekly, reconcile active headcount by cost center from the HRIS into the finance team's budget Google Sheet, updating actuals and adding rows for new cost centers.
When a background check result comes back in Checkr, update the candidate's status in Lever and post the clear/consider outcome to the recruiter's Slack DM.
When a wage garnishment order is logged in the HR legal tracker sheet, create the corresponding deduction in the payroll system with amount, cap, and start date.
Sync license and certification expiry dates from the credentialing sheet into each employee's HRIS profile and create Asana renewal tasks for those expiring within 60 days.
When a new hire record is created in the HRIS, create an onboarding project in Asana from the role-specific template with tasks assigned to IT, facilities, and the hiring manager.
When an employee updates their home address in BambooHR, update the same address in the payroll system and the benefits portal, flagging state changes that affect tax withholding.
Sync campus-recruiting candidates from the career fair sign-up Google Sheet into HubSpot as contacts with university, graduation year, and target role, deduplicating by email.
Monthly, read approved remote-work stipend claims from the Expensify report and add them as non-taxable reimbursements on each employee's payroll in Gusto.
At week end, read hourly employees' hours from the Deputy timesheet export and enter regular and overtime hours into payroll, splitting hours above 40 into overtime.
When an exit interview survey is submitted in Typeform, copy the termination reason and regrettable-loss flag into the departed employee's HRIS record and the attrition tracking sheet.
When a promotion is approved in Workday, update the employee's job title in Google Workspace directory, Slack profile, and the email signature tracking sheet.
Sync work authorization expiry dates from the immigration counsel's shared sheet into the HRIS and create Zendesk tickets for HR to begin renewals 120 days before expiry.
When a hire is confirmed in the HRIS, create a row in the IT equipment request sheet with laptop spec and ship-to address based on role and remote status.
When an employee submits a qualifying life event form in the HR helpdesk (Freshdesk), update dependents in the benefits portal and adjust the premium deduction in payroll.
When an internal transfer is approved in the HR request tracker, update the employee's department, location, and cost center in the HRIS and move their row in the department roster sheets.
When managers nominate employees for leadership training in the nomination Google Form sheet, register them in the LMS cohort and add the session dates to their Google Calendars.
When a termination is entered in the HRIS, create the final-pay record in payroll with last day worked and unused PTO payout hours from the time-off tracker.
rule_hooks: state final pay and PTO payout laws

scenario: On each employee's service anniversary, update their PTO accrual rate in the HRIS time-off policy per the tenure tier and log the change in the accrual audit sheet.
After each new-hire orientation Zoom meeting, read the attendance report and mark the orientation task complete in each attendee's Asana onboarding project.
When a new sales hire is added in the HRIS, create their Salesforce user record with role, territory, and ramp quota from the sales comp plan sheet.
When employees sign the updated handbook acknowledgment in DocuSign, record the signed date in the HRIS and update the acknowledgment status column in the compliance tracker sheet.
Copy voluntary self-identification answers from the new-hire intake form into the restricted EEO-1 reporting sheet, mapping responses to the official EEO-1 job categories and race/ethnicity codes.

When a hiring manager posts interview debrief notes in a Slack thread, copy each interviewer's hire/no-hire decision and summary into the matching candidate's stage feedback in Greenhouse, flagging missing interviewers.
rule_hooks: panel roster per stage, required interviewer count

scenario: When a headcount request row in the finance-approved Google Sheet flips to Approved, open the matching job requisition in the ATS with the approved level, salary band, cost center and hiring manager.
rule_hooks: approval status, salary band table by level

scenario: When a recruiting agency emails a candidate submission to the recruiting Gmail inbox, create or update the candidate in the ATS with source=agency and the agency name, rejecting duplicates already in the pipeline within the ownership window.
rule_hooks: agency ownership window, duplicate candidate rules

scenario: When an offer is marked Extended in the ATS, append the base, bonus target, equity grant and start date to the compensation approvals Google Sheet and mark offers above band midpoint for VP review.

When the board-approved grants spreadsheet is updated after a board meeting, create matching option grant records in Carta for each new hire or refresher, using HRIS employee IDs and vesting schedule codes.
rule_hooks: vesting schedule codes, grant type mapping

scenario: When a new hire record becomes Active in BambooHR, create or update their profile in the company Notion directory with title, team, location, manager and start date.

When a relocation package is approved in the HR helpdesk ticket, copy the employee's origin, destination, move date and package tier into the relocation vendor's shared Google Sheet and update the ticket with the vendor reference.
rule_hooks: relocation package tiers, eligibility by level

scenario: When an employee's work location changes in the HRIS (e.g., remote state move), update the work state and local tax jurisdiction in Gusto and open a task for HR if the new state has no payroll registration.
rule_hooks: registered payroll states list, tax jurisdiction mapping

scenario: When an employee submits a direct deposit change form via the HR helpdesk, update the bank details in the payroll system only after a callback verification is logged on the ticket, and record the change date in the audit sheet.

At month close, read approved commission amounts from the sales comp Google Sheet and enter them as one-time earnings for the matching employees in the next payroll run, skipping reps marked as terminated in the HRIS.
rule_hooks: approval flag, employment status, earning codes

scenario: Read the weekly schedule export from When I Work and sync night and weekend hours into the payroll system as shift-differential earnings per employee.
rule_hooks: shift differential rates by shift type

scenario: When the retirement plan provider's weekly change file lands in Gmail, update each employee's 401(k) deferral percentage in payroll and log any employees not found or exceeding the IRS limit.
rule_hooks: annual contribution limits, effective date by pay period

scenario: After each payroll run, copy per-employee HSA payroll deductions and employer contributions from the payroll register into the HSA custodian's contribution upload sheet, reconciling against elected amounts.
rule_hooks: elected HSA amounts, family vs self-only limits

scenario: When dependent eligibility documents are marked Verified or Rejected in the benefits helpdesk queue, update the dependent's coverage status in the benefits admin platform and notify the employee via email.

When a termination is recorded in the HRIS for a benefits-enrolled employee, create a COBRA qualifying event entry in the COBRA administrator's tracking sheet with coverage end date and enrolled plans.
rule_hooks: coverage end rule (end of month), enrolled plans

scenario: When employees submit wellness reimbursement requests through a Typeform, add approved claims to the wellness ledger sheet and deduct from each employee's annual remaining balance, rejecting claims over the remaining balance.
rule_hooks: annual stipend cap, eligible expense categories

scenario: When a new hire record is created in the HRIS, enroll them in the required compliance courses in the LMS based on their state and role (e.g., harassment prevention for CA/NY managers) with due dates relative to start date.

Weekly, read overdue mandatory course assignments from the LMS and create or update a follow-up task in each manager's Asana project listing their overdue reports, closing tasks when completions sync.
rule_hooks: mandatory course list, overdue grace period

scenario: When quarterly OKRs are finalized in the team Google Sheet, create matching individual goals in Lattice for each owner with the key results, weights and due date.

When a manager opens a performance improvement plan in the HR helpdesk, create a confidential record in the ER case tracker sheet with check-in dates and set private calendar reminders for HRBP and manager.

After merit cycle sign-off, read final increases from the compensation planning sheet and update base salary and effective date in the HRIS, skipping employees with leave status or out-of-band amounts pending exception approval.
When the annual bonus payout sheet is approved by finance, enter each eligible employee's bonus as a supplemental earning in payroll and prorate for hires mid-year per the eligibility rules.
rule_hooks: proration by hire date, minimum tenure eligibility

scenario: When an employee relations complaint is submitted via the ethics hotline email, create a case in the HR case management tool with category, involved parties and assigned investigator, and mirror the status to the restricted ER Google Sheet.
rule_hooks: case category routing, investigator assignment by region

scenario: When an ADA accommodation request is approved in the HR helpdesk, create a facilities work order in Jira Service Management with only the needed equipment and location, omitting medical details.

When a workplace injury report is submitted via the safety Google Form, log it in the OSHA 300 incident sheet and create a claim entry in the workers' comp carrier portal tracker with lost-days field.

When an employee submits a jury duty summons in the HR helpdesk, create the jury duty leave entries in the timekeeping system for the dates and set the pay code based on state-specific paid jury duty rules.
rule_hooks: state jury duty pay rules, max paid days

scenario: When HR publishes next year's holiday calendar in the shared Google Sheet, create the company holidays in the HRIS time-off calendar and in the shared Google Calendar per country office.
rule_hooks: holidays by country, floating holiday rules

scenario: When a parental leave is approved in the leave tracker, update the employee's payroll status to the paid parental leave earning code and notify the benefits platform to continue premiums during leave.
rule_hooks: paid leave weeks by tenure, premium continuation

scenario: When a return-to-work date passes in the leave tracker sheet, reactivate the employee in the HRIS, restore their Okta access groups, and remove the leave banner in Slack profile status.
rule_hooks: return date, prior access group snapshot

scenario: When an engagement survey closes in Culture Amp, copy team-level scores into the HR leadership Google Sheet dashboard, suppressing teams below the minimum respondent count.
When a spot award is approved in the Bonusly/recognition Slack channel, add the cash award amount to the employee's next payroll as taxable supplemental pay and log it in the awards ledger.
rule_hooks: award value caps, taxable fringe rules

scenario: When the intern cohort list is finalized in the university recruiting sheet, create intern records in the HRIS with fixed end dates and add each to the intern Slack channel and the mentorship pairing sheet.

When a contractor's conversion to full-time is approved, close their vendor record in QuickBooks, create the employee record in the HRIS with the original contract start as service date, and update their Okta type.
rule_hooks: service date carryover policy, worker type mapping

scenario: When a contractor invoice arrives in Gmail, compare the billed hours against approved hours in the project timesheet sheet and create the bill in Xero only for matching amounts, flagging overbilling to the hiring manager.

When an employee submits a legal name change through the HR helpdesk with documentation, update the name in the HRIS, payroll, benefits platform and email display name, keeping preferred name fields separate.
rule_hooks: legal vs preferred name rules, documentation required

scenario: Nightly, sync emergency contact details from the HRIS to the site safety roster Google Sheet for each office location, removing terminated employees.
When the union sends a monthly membership roster via email, update union dues deductions in payroll for covered employees, adding new members and stopping dues for withdrawals.
rule_hooks: dues rates by bargaining unit, authorization cards

scenario: When a hire under 18 is created in the HRIS for a retail location, add them to the minor work permit tracker sheet and configure scheduling restrictions in the shift scheduling tool.
rule_hooks: state child labor hour limits, permit requirements

scenario: When a former employee applies in the ATS, look up their termination record in the HRIS and set the rehire-eligible flag and prior tenure on the candidate profile.
When a job description doc in Google Drive is marked Approved by the comp team, update the job posting description, level and pay transparency range on the matching ATS requisition.
rule_hooks: pay transparency laws by state, level ranges
